title: Saturn slips behind a moon
description:
Astronomers say only a strip of Earth saw the Moon hide Saturn in 2025, from Greenland to northern Africa. The next time is 2031.
NASA picture: JPL, PIA21889. Cassini, Enceladus and Saturn, 2017.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Roberto Ortu: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-10-saturn-behind-the-moon/. To use it, please ask the owner.
